notes: Data taken from the official Symetrix "Radius NX 4x4 Data Sheet" (Copyright 2022, symetrix.co). Analog I/O uses 3.81mm captive screw terminal blocks, mapped here to euroblock (closest connector id). The two Dante ports (labeled C & D, RJ45/1000 Base-T) are only active if the optional factory-installed Dante card is present — modeled here since Dante is a headline feature of this SKU; datasheet states 128 (64x64) channel capacity, primary+secondary redundant, 1000 Base-T = eth-1g. The two Ethernet ports (A & B) are 1000 Base-T for Composer/control, also graded eth-1g. USB Host port is a standard USB-A port for flash-drive playback/record (not audio-class); USB Audio port is a separate USB-B 2.0 port for computer audio I/O — graded usb-2.0 per datasheet ("2.0 with Audio class 1.0 legacy modes"). ARC port is RJ45 but proprietary (distributes power + RS-485 to ARC wall panels, not general Ethernet) — included as bidirectional RJ45 with no grade since it is not an IEEE eth-speed-graded link. Logic Outputs (4) and External Control Inputs (2, usable as 2 pots or 4 switch inputs) are on a terminal block connector, mapped to euroblock; treated as control ports (no grade). Power input is an IEC C14 inlet (detachable IEC cable, 100-240VAC, 50/60Hz, 60W max) — mapped to "iec". The rear panel also has a 4-channel expansion card slot (accepts optional I/O cards) and a factory reset switch — these are not standard signal/power connectors from the provided list and were omitted. RS-485 can optionally be broken out of the ARC port per the datasheet but is not a separate physical connector, so not listed separately.
